presets.name: Smooth four-stage swirl
presets.desc: Four JFET-style stages, no feedback, slow sine sweep: a smooth, vocal swirl on clean or lightly driven guitar

refs.why: Gilmour moved from the Uni-Vibe to a Phase 90 around 1974

presets.notes: README 'Phase 90 script'; wet = dry for the deepest notches (law dry + wet · phased); mono LFO like the pedal, before the amp

presets.name: Phased hot-rod lead
presets.desc: Feedback-free four-stage phaser in front of a cranked amp: a slow swoosh that adds bite and treble to riffs and solos

refs.why: Eddie's MXR Phase 90 into a cranked amp

presets.notes: Place before the drive/amp: the sweep then shapes what distorts; color 60 adds a little more JFET saturation

presets.name: Pronounced four-stage phase
presets.desc: Four stages with the internal feedback resistor at 1 Hz: a sharper, more resonant, throatier swoosh
presets.notes: README 'Phase 90 block'; the feedback is fixed by the model (the Feedback control is ignored here)

presets.name: Choppy funk rhythm phase
presets.desc: Faster smooth four-stage phase on clean single-note and chord stabs: movement that pulses with sixteenths
presets.notes: Speed near the middle of a Phase 90's knob; range nudged up so the sweep lives in the funk guitar's 500 Hz – 2 kHz

presets.name: Touch-sensitive auto-phase
presets.desc: Picking dynamics sweep a resonant four-stage phaser: each stab quacks up and settles back as it decays
presets.notes: README 'Funk auto-phase'; manual 0 parks the rest position at Low so every attack sweeps upward

presets.name: Slow resonant OTA swirl
presets.desc: Four OTA stages at 0.3 Hz with the color switch's feedback in: a deep, liquid, resonant swirl
presets.notes: README 'Small Stone swirl'; on Stone the colour above 50 % is the feedback (the Feedback control is ignored)

presets.name: Throbbing vibe chorus
presets.desc: Four unequal lamp-driven stages: the pulsing, throbbing, rotary-like vibe swirl in front of a driven amp

refs.why: Uni-Vibe throb at the Fillmore East, Band of Gypsys
Uni-Vibe with a cranked amp, middle pickup

presets.notes: README 'Uni-Vibe' application; place before the amp; the rate drifts up with depth like the original

presets.name: Slow lush vibe
presets.desc: The vibe's unequal stages swept slowly with a lazy lamp: a lush, breathing movement for slow clean or bluesy parts

refs.why: Uni-Vibe in David Gilmour's Dark Side of the Moon-era rig

presets.notes: Longer lamp lag smooths the sweep; tone 45 darkens the wet slightly

presets.name: Mirrored dual stereo phase
presets.desc: Two six-stage phasers, left and right, swept in opposite directions: a wide, three-dimensional phase wall

refs.why: Butch Vig: guitars ran through a Mu-Tron Bi-Phase

presets.notes: README 'Bi-Phase stereo sweep'; Parallel = A left / B right, mirrored LFO; on a mono output both are averaged

presets.name: Bass phase, lows untouched
presets.desc: Smooth four-stage phase on bass above 120 Hz: the growl and slap sweep while the fundamental stays solid
presets.notes: README 'Bass' application; bass_keep 120 Hz complementary split keeps the low end dry and mono

presets.name: Electric piano phase
presets.desc: Slow resonant OTA phase on electric piano or clavinet: the 70s soul and jazz-funk keyboard swirl
presets.notes: Stereo quadrature for keys; bass_keep 100 Hz so the left hand does not swirl

presets.name: Phased string machine
presets.desc: Very slow, resonant OTA phase on string-machine or pad chords: a sweeping, cosmic 70s synth texture

refs.why: string machine through a Small Stone-type phaser

presets.notes: Slower and more resonant than rhodes-phase; pairs with gfx-chorus string-ensemble before it

presets.name: Deep six-octave pad sweep
presets.desc: Twelve stages swept over six octaves at 0.1 Hz with feedback: six notches gliding slowly through a pad
presets.notes: README 'Deep slow sweep'; 100 Hz – 6.4 kHz is exactly six octaves

presets.name: Endless rising phase
presets.desc: Eight-stage barber-pole phaser: the notches climb forever with no audible reset, for builds and risers
presets.notes: README 'Endless rise'; two crossfaded sawtooth cascades

presets.name: Expression-pedal phase
presets.desc: No LFO: six resonant stages swept by the EXP pedal on Manual, a wah-like but hollow vocal sweep
presets.notes: README 'Phase with the foot': map the EXP pedal to manual (0 = Low, 100 = High), exponential and click-free

presets.name: Stepped sample-and-hold phase
presets.desc: Eight resonant stages jumping to a new random position every eighth note, locked to tempo: robotic synth motion
presets.notes: README 'Sample-and-hold phase'; Steps is lightly smoothed so the jumps do not click

presets.name: Psychedelic vocal phase
presets.desc: Gentle four-stage phase at a lower wet level on a vocal: slow, airy movement on sustained words
presets.notes: Wet -6 dB: partial notches keep the words intelligible; bass_keep 150 Hz holds the chest of the voice

presets.name: Phased drum bus
presets.desc: Slow six-stage phase across drums or a loop: cymbals and room swirl while the kick stays dry
presets.notes: High range up to 8 kHz so the cymbals carry the sweep; bass_keep 150 Hz keeps kick and floor tom solid
